name: OpenSpec
description: Installs the OpenSpec CLI (openspec) from the npm registry, verifying every package's integrity hash and registry signature, on a Node.js runtime it brings in as a dependency.

version.description: The OpenSpec version to install: 'latest' (the version the npm registry names as latest at build time) or one exact published version such as 1.13.1. Any other value, such as a range, fails the build.

disableUpdateCheck.description: Run openspec with OPENSPEC_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1, which skips the version check inside `openspec update`, unless the caller's environment already sets that variable.

disableTelemetry.description: Run openspec with OPENSPEC_TELEMETRY=0, which turns its usage telemetry off, unless the caller's environment already sets that variable.
